title: GPU METAL LAYER — The Green Null Spectrum Topology
principle: Green is the NULL spectrum — same reason NVIDIA uses green. Humans detect the widest spread there. It is the most information-dense where grey and static meet as triad. The GPUs ARE the first metal layer of topology.

green_physics.why_green: Human eyes have peak sensitivity at ~555nm (green). More photoreceptors respond to green than any other color.
green_physics.nvidia_green: NVIDIA chose green because green = maximum information throughput in human vision
green_physics.null_spectrum: Green is where RGB overlaps maximally — it's the NULL point where all channels contribute equally
green_physics.grey_triad: Grey = equal R+G+B. Static = random R+G+B. Green sits between as the axis of maximum sensitivity.
green_physics.chroma_key: Green screen works because human vision has highest resolution in green — easiest to cleanly separate
